title: Cooperation Yields Agency
hero_prompt: A wide horizontal hand-drawn scientific engraving in the style of Ernst Haeckel's Kunstformen der Natur, ~12:5 aspect ratio. Two distinct organisms — one branching coral-like structure on the left, one radiating anemone-like structure on the right — meeting at center where their roots interweave and fuse into a single shared stem. From the fused stem, one luminous bloom rises upward, more radiant and complex than either parent could produce alone. Fine cross-hatched linework, sepia and deep indigo ink on aged parchment, symmetrical bilateral composition, delicate biological precision. Both organisms retain their distinct character — the merger amplifies rather than erases. Muted tones so the image reads when darkened as a backdrop. No text, no letters, no labels, purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: A bold high-contrast emblem: two interlocking curved forms — like two crescents or two seed-halves — fused at the center into a single unified shape that reads as one AND two simultaneously. Woodcut-style thick black lines on cream, strong silhouette, symmetrical, no fine linework. Survives at 24 pixels. Purely pictorial, no text.
